blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In trade, there are two main people. One is the buyer. The buyer buys. The other is the seller. The seller sells.

At Czarnikow, we help buyers and sellers. We help them make good deals. A deal is a plan to buy and sell. The buyer and the seller sign a contract.

Today you learn 5 words and the pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Each short sentence is a win. You can do it!

items.q: What does the buyer do?
items.why: "The buyer buys." — comprador compra.

items.q: Who does Czarnikow help?
items.why: "we help buyers and sellers."

items.q: What is a deal?
options: A plan to buy and sell
items.why: "A deal is a plan to buy and sell."

items.q: The text says "Each short sentence is a win." This suggests that…
options: small steps are good in learning
items.why: Inferência: frases curtas contam como progresso — passos pequenos são bons.

items.q: The buyer and the seller sign a contract. This suggests that…
options: they agree on the deal together
they work alone, with no plan
items.why: Inferência: assinar o contrato mostra que os dois concordam com o acordo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan mostrar um negócio simples ao novo trader. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi. I am Ethan. Come and look at this deal with me. It is simple, so do not worry.

Here is one buyer. The buyer is in India. He wants sugar. He wants a good price. Now look here. This is the seller. The seller is in Brazil. She has the sugar. She wants to sell it.

In the middle, we have a contract. The contract has the price and the date. It has the name of the buyer and the name of the seller too. The buyer reads it. The seller reads it. Then the buyer signs, and the seller signs. Now it is a deal.

The buyer is our client. The seller is our supplier. We are the brokers. We are in the middle. We help both people. We help them talk. We help them make a good deal.

You are new here today, but do not worry. This deal is small and clear. One buyer, one seller, one contract. That is all. You and I, we work on it together. Ask me your questions. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where is the buyer?
items.why: "The buyer is in India."

items.q: What does the seller have?
items.why: "She has the sugar. She wants to sell."

items.q: Who signs the contract?
items.why: "The buyer signs, and the seller signs."

items.q: Ethan calls this deal "small and clear." This suggests that…
options: it is a good deal to learn with
it is too hard for a new trader
items.why: Inferência: um negócio pequeno e claro é fácil para começar a aprender.

items.q: Ethan says "You and I, we work on it together." This suggests that…
options: Ethan will help the new trader
items.why: Inferência: "together" mostra apoio — Ethan vai ajudar o novo trader.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The buyer is in India and wants sugar." A buyer is a person who…
items.why: Buyer = comprador, quem compra.

items.q: "The seller is in Brazil." A seller is a person who…
items.why: Seller = vendedor, quem vende.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The buyer is our ___. We help this person buy."
items.why: Client = cliente, a pessoa que ajudamos a comprar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The seller gives us the sugar. The seller is our ___."
items.why: Supplier = fornecedor, quem fornece o produto.

items.q: "The buyer and the seller sign a contract." A contract is…
options: a written deal with the terms
items.why: Contract = contrato, o acordo escrito com os termos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de negócios. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the contract." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We close a deal with the buyer today." To close a deal means to…
items.why: Close a deal = fechar o negócio, finalizar o acordo.

items.q: "I will follow up with the seller tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar sequência, entrar em contato de novo para acompanhar.

items.q: "The buyer pushed back on the price." This means the buyer…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "Let's sort out the date before we sign." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, acertar algo.
